patches.name: Add 4x playback speed
patches.description: Adds 4x fast-forward speed option to camera SD card playback.

patches.name: Fix playback freeze at clip boundaries
patches.description: Fixes SD card playback freezing at clip ends by auto-advancing to consecutive fragments.
